_comment: Copy to framecue.local.json and fill in. That file is git-ignored. The values are embedded at build time, so rebuild with `npm run android` after editing (D-010).
_supabaseUrl: Hosted Supabase project URL, e.g. https://abcdefgh.supabase.co
_supabasePublishableKey: Project Settings > API Keys > publishable key (sb_publishable_...). Not a secret: RLS and the edge functions decide what it can do.
_inviteHost: Host serving web/invite, without https://, e.g. yourname.github.io. Invitation and sign-in links are App Links on this host.
